plan.title: F5/F6 Stage A - Populate file_size and modified_at (fast)

narratives.Overview: Populate the cheap half of the new columns from FileManager attributes during scan, plus an eager backfill for existing libraries. Delivers F5's win almost immediately.
narratives.Problem:
AssetGridView.swift:644 re-stats every file whenever sort-by-size is triggered, because size is never persisted.

Note a correction to the audit: this path already runs inside Task.detached(priority: .utility) -- it is off-main AND already downgraded. The defect is the missing persistence, not the threading.
narratives.Action: Populate during scan; eager backfill on first launch after upgrade. Over ~1,300 files this is milliseconds -- stat calls only, no AVFoundation.
narratives.Constraint: Eager backfill is user-visible and must be: progress-indicated, resumable across app kill, cancellable with lazy fallback, and non-blocking for features that do not need the columns.

items.title: file_size and modified_at populated during scan
Sorting by size issues NO attributesOfItem calls, asserted in a test
Backfill populates existing libraries without a full rescan, and is resumable
Sort order byte-identical to today for an unchanged library (characterization test)
Stale entries detected and refreshed when a file changes on disk
Progress indicated; cancellation degrades to lazy population
